rationale: Worker3 has DuckDB and approximately 42GB available RAM. Bound this offline inventory to two CPU threads and 4GB working memory with disk spill; preserve 1GiB operational disk reserve in addition to each declared tar member size. Source acquisition must finish naturally and its final record SHA256 be explicitly pinned at launch. Never read a partial corpus, infer missing IDs/timestamps, select evaluation windows from outcomes, or treat this inventory as replay/model acceptance. Operational resource limits are not scientific decision thresholds. Revalidate in a new exclusive directory after the first validator glob accidentally included the dataset directory ending in .parquet alongside its 2000 regular files, doubling reader input. Physical-file footer inventory has 69182074 rows; this is a diagnostic, not an acceptance target hardcoded in the validator. Filter regular files, then repeat full archive/values/nulls/identity checks; preserve the original failed output and gates.
